answer: A proof-of-transit protocol curbs Sybil attacks among autonomous drones surveying a glacier. Nodes submit verifiable inertial trajectory proofs recorded during each physical voyage between anchor beacons. An adversary incurs the real cost of deploying distinct physical hardware and battery reserves per identity, making effortless persona duplication an economic fable. However, sensor drift in freezing temperatures can degrade dead-reckoning accuracy, causing false rejections of valid nodes.
